children: Modine will become Modexus Solutions after spinning off its Performance Technologies business and merging with Gentherm.
Announced name change to Modexus Solutions, subject to shareholder approval of Articles amendment.
Change follows spin‑off of Performance Technologies and Gentherm merger; expected close on Oct 1, 2026.
Will continue trading on NYSE under current ticker "MOD" once the name change is effective.
Leadership remains Neil D. Brinker as CEO and Michael Lucareli as CFO; current board to continue.
Company expects to call a special stockholder meeting to vote on the name change within three months of closing.
